title: Expedition X
description:
S12 E01 — Robin Hood's Ghosts
The team travels to Nottingham, home to the legend of Robin Hood; as they investigate whether centuries of bloodshed have left a paranormal legacy of terror, their search leads them to Sherwood Forest, and a seeming encounter with the restless dead.

title: Expedition X
description:
S12 E02 — Secrets of Sherwood Forest
Phil and Heather continue their investigation into the dark legend of Robin Hood in Nottingham, England; while exploring reports of hostile ghosts in a medieval prison and sinister pagan rituals in Sherwood Forest, the team uncovers shocking answers.

title: Expedition X
description:
S10 E06 — Spanish Zombies
The team visits Galicia in search of the Santa Compaña -- an unholy horde of the undead terrorizing rural Spain. Their quest for these Spanish zombies leads them to a remote monastery in the countryside, rumored to be the site of dark rituals.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S05 E01 — Jungle of the Damned
At an infamous prison in the Amazon, dangerous criminals faced hard labor, a hostile environment and death by guillotine; today, it's deserted and new discoveries reveal why this hellish compound was built and abandoned.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S13 E14 — Don't Call It Crapple
Kitchen trouble forces Tickle to shut down his restaurant; Josh proposes they make carrot-apple moonshine to raise the $8,000 needed to reopen.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E07 — Road Rage on the Underage
Tizzy investigates a driver who violently assaults a teenage boy riding a bike. A customer catches a brazen shoplifter, and a woman nearly runs over her boyfriend at a gas station.

title: Orange County Choppers Original
description:
S01 E05 — Frantastic
The crew from OCC sits down with the Avian Veteran Alliance and Tampa Bay Raptor Rescue to help veterans find connection through wildlife while Joannie cuddles a kangaroo joey. Will the crew have enough time to finish the bike?

title: Adventure Cities
description:
S03 E01 — Port of Spain, Trinidad
Seasoned travel writer Jonathan Thompson explores beyond the tourist trail, discovering the lush landscapes, hidden waterfalls and laid-back rhythms of Trinidad.

title: RV There Yet?
description:
S05 E10 — Prince William County, VA
Patrice and Kevin McCabe visited Prince William County in Virginia to check out the Occoquan Bay National Wildlife Refuge and Repeal Speakeasy Restaurant.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S02 E02 — Double Hurricane Disaster
In 2024, hundreds of cameras capture hurricanes slamming Florida's Gulf Coast; as category four Hurricane Helene brings record flooding, residents have no chance to recover before category three Hurricane Milton unleashes over 40 tornadoes.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E01 — Nightmare in May
In mid-May 2025, hundreds of eyewitnesses capture the power of severe weather as supercell thunderstorms unleash dozens of powerful tornadoes, tossing vehicles across highways and destroying neighborhoods and workplaces in eleven states.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E11 — Father's Day Fury
A rogue storm in the Texas Panhandle ignites a monster outbreak, unleashing over 80 tornadoes across 14 states; witnesses scramble for safety as a deadly EF3 cuts power and silences tornado sirens.

title: Naked and Afraid: Shipwrecked
description:
S01 E04 — Typhoon Warning
Stung by Patrick's criticism, Allison gathers debris to craft an improvised fishing net; a tropical storm pounds all four camps; Mandy and Adam must abandon their battered shelter and push into the dense jungle.

title: Naked and Afraid: Shipwrecked
description:
S01 E05 — Smoke Signals and Fire Fights
Spotting smoke on a distant shore, a team pushes to find another camp; the jungle trek has Mandy at her breaking point; Dani and Jarrell's clashing survival styles spark a blowout fight; a survivalist is medically evacuated from the challenge.

title: Naked and Afraid: Shipwrecked
description:
S01 E06 — Spewing and Stinging Venom
Dani and Jarrell's heated fight splinters their camp, forcing Jamie to pick sides; a hunt leads to a food win in another camp; as teams merge, dynamics begin to shift; a stingray attack puts a survivalist at risk.

title: Naked and Afraid: Shipwrecked
description:
S01 E07 — The Lost Coast's Revenge
Jamie battles searing pain and a deadly infection after the stingray attack; Malu and Mandy struggle with Ana Lis' survival priorities.

title: Naked and Afraid: Shipwrecked
description:
S01 E08 — S.O.S. Turns Into 9-1-1
Two scout teams attempt grueling journeys to reach a signal tower. One team struggles to crest a ridgeline, and the other takes on 12 miles of Lost Coast seas. A survivalist slips out of consciousness. The medical emergency upends the challenge.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S18 E11 — Three Is Not Enough
After surviving a 14-day fan challenge, three survivalists attempt to endure 21 days in the rainy, mosquito-infested Belizean jungle; one is forced to leave due to a family emergency.

title: Naked and Afraid: Shipwrecked
description:
S01 E08 — S.O.S. Turns Into 9-1-1

description:
S18 E11 — Three Is Not Enough
After surviving a 14-day fan challenge, three survivalists attempt to endure 21 days in the rainy, mosquito-infested Belizean jungle; one is forced to leave due to a family emergency.

title: Truck Dynasty
description:
S01 E05 — Blood Red Redemption
A repeat client, Kim, calls as the company is about to leave their old shop; he wants an off-roading truck to comfortably seat his 11-person family, so Joe must get creative; Ashley's family revolts when Joe changes how sales calls are handled.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S13 E15 — Cowboy Legacy
Mark and Digger invent a high-proof thump keg; news breaks that their friend Cowboy has been killed; they hurry to retrieve a barrel he was tending; Tickle puts faith in an unproven recipe to save his restaurant; Jerry designs a solar mash fermenter.

title: Lone Star Law
description:
S09 E04 — Deadly Spill
Game Warden Randolph McGee assesses a major gasoline spill in the local water system then tracks down a trash dumping culprit; young jet skiers are confronted, and game warden Mike Boone helps relocate an alligator.

title: Lone Star Law
description:
S09 E05 — Sunk in Seconds
On Sam Rayburn Lake, Game Wardens Morgan Inman and Austin Cryer discover that a brave citizen rescued passengers from a swamped boat; doves are found dead from a suspected poisoning; alligators are found on school property.

title: Lone Star Law
description:
S09 E06 — Lake Showdown
A drunken man wreaks havoc on Sam Rayburn Lake; Wardens Randy Sovall and Sean Reneau deal with the aftermath; Warden Mike Boone tracks down the culprits responsible for an illegal dumpsite; a gator is residing in a family's pond.

title: Lone Star Law
description:
S09 E07 — Sparking Disaster
During wildfire season, Warden Dustin Delgado catches people throwing out lit cigarettes and stops them; Warden Cynde Aguilar helps hunt down the criminal involved in a high-speed chase; a call is made about a gator lurking in a pond.

title: Lone Star Law
description:
S09 E08 — Actions Have Consequences
Game Warden Cummings arrives at the scene of a domestic dispute only to discover the man has a warrant out for his arrest; during water patrols, a fisherman is caught empty-handed; a couple and their baby are kayaking without life jackets.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E01 — Clay County Detention Center
In Clay County, Mississippi, where gun deaths are an epidemic and the median income sits 66% below the national average, Sheriff Scott and his team fight to keep order inside a jail where the consequences of a community in crisis arrive daily.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E04 — Wood County Jail
After nearly two decades of economic decline and a surge in methamphetamine use, Wood County, Wisconsin opens a new $93 million jail, where staff faces mounting pressure to help a community searching for a way forward.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E06 — Flagler County Jail
At Florida's Flagler County Jail, law and order Sheriff Rick Staly takes a tough approach to corrections while battling the revolving door of repeat offenders through discipline, rehabilitation, and recovery programs.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S01 E08 — Washoe County Jail
Inside one of Nevada's busiest jails, deputies battle a non-stop surge of arrests driven by Reno's constant crime and a major trafficking corridor; with gangs entrenched inside, keeping rival groups apart becomes a daily fight for control.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S01 E03 — Clayton County, Georgia
Behind the walls of Clayton County Jail, deteriorating infrastructure creates dangerous conditions for both inmates and staff.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
description:
S01 E12 — Catch 'Em All
An agriculture dog alerts to a suitcase coming from Ethiopia, and inspection reveals a tough hide; a plain-clothes officer in baggage claim finds a passenger acting suspiciously; a woman from Japan accuses officers of assuming she's a prostitute.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
description:
S01 E09 — A Hard Pill to Swallow
Officers find a fraudulent passport hidden in a video game case, a telltale sign of criminals at work; a traveler who just returns from Paris claims she has nothing to declare, but a search of her bags reveals a suspicious $200,000 diamond watch.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
description:
S01 E08 — The Call of Duties
Officers find chessboards loaded with more than 32 pieces; a couple who claimed only half the purchases they made abroad face a hefty fine and having their items seized; two travelers attempting to avoid immigration questions get caught.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
description:
S01 E04 — It's Not Supposed to Be Sticky
While officers inspect a cargo shipment for illegal marijuana, an X-ray reveals some lewd contents; a character attracts officers' attention for bringing medications they suspect he intends to sell at an alternative lifestyle festival.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
The Car-tell
Every year, CBP officers process thousands of vehicles. Some look ordinary, and others are built to deceive -- because at the border, four wheels and an engine could be a cover for contraband.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E10 — Utah County Jail
In Utah County, Sheriff Mike Smith runs a behavior-based jail, where good conduct earns inmates greater privileges and access to programs built to break the cycle of recidivism.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E09 — Indian River County Jail
On Florida's Treasure Coast, home to some of the priciest real estate in the state, Indian River County Jail serves the people who wealth left behind. Deputies invest in programs, mentorship and second chances to keep them from coming back.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S01 E07 — Butler County Jail
Inside Butler County Jail, a six-term sheriff and his seasoned staff confront an opioid crisis; as drugs flood the facility, officers work to dismantle the supply ring and maintain order.

title: Street Outlaws: Locals Only
description:
S02 E14 — Scoot Over, Scott
Locals race in Alabama for $5,000; the winner goes up against Scott Taylor, but when he surprises everyone by bringing his small-tire car, the negotiations get trickier.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S13 E16 — The Curse of Oaked Bourbon
After tasting their best barrel yet, Mark and Digger make a run to rival $2,000 bourbon; Tickle makes a daring deal selling shine at a wrestling match to reopen his restaurant; Mike faces the prospect of Richard's revenge.

title: Moonshiners: Master Distiller
description:
S05 E05 — American Agave
By law, tequila and mezcal can only be made in Mexico, but outlaw distillers follow their own set of rules; three of the best bring American ingenuity to a 500-year-old recipe, but only one will be named Master Distiller.

title: Moonshiners: Master Distiller
description:
S05 E06 — Firehouse Flameout
Three firefighters famous for their shine compete to run their best off-duty recipes; veteran firemen Tim and Mark taste the results and, along with Digger, pay tribute to the history between the brotherhoods of firefighting and moonshining.

title: Moonshiners: Master Distiller
description:
S05 E18 — Still Builder Showdown
In the first-ever combo competition, three craftsmen-distillers compete to build working stills from raw sheet copper while mashing in a run of liquor from scratch ingredients; with catastrophic failure at stake, winning comes down to the final jar.

title: Sin City Tow
description:
S01 E01 — Car Sharks
Tow truck drivers hunt for illegally parked cars in Las Vegas; a driver gambles and accepts payment in casino chips; an urgent tow is needed at a drive-through wedding chapel; a big rig tow leads to a tense standoff; a tow truck driver is attacked.

title: Sin City Tow
description:
S01 E02 — Bachelor Party Foul
Sparks fly at a strip club when TW's tow interrupts a bachelor party; Jeremy and Elmer join forces to tow an untouchable car, which leads to a standoff with the angry owners; A car owner gives Pineapple a kinky proposition.

title: Sin City Tow
description:
S01 E08 — Formula One Frenzy
It's a race for the most tows as thousands of fans descend on Las Vegas for the Formula One Grand Prix; TW subdues a raunchy party while Shawn confronts a racegoer carrying a big wrench; Elmer's frustrations with The Tow Truck Company come to a head.

title: Sin City Tow
description:
S01 E09 — Mutiny At TTC
Tensions run high on the streets of Las Vegas as the year comes to a close; Elmer has a blowout with his boss; Pineapple rips into a new driver over their worst tow ever; Nick deals with a raging customer.

title: Caught!
description:
S01 E16 — SWAT Teams Unleashed
Witnessing elite police units execute daring raids and high-stakes takedowns nationwide; from Florida's fiery standoffs to tense hostage crises, experience the relentless courage of these specially-trained officers.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E03 — Security Cam Chaos
Security cameras in front yards, backyards, storefronts and street corners capture crimes, mishaps and earth-shattering moments like break-ins. When lives are at risk, it is up to local law enforcement and communities to save the day.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E16 — Retail Fails
Shopping trips are part of everyone's daily routines, but if tensions flare between angry customers and fed-up workers, it can result in more than just damaged goods.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E19 — Service Without a Smile
Serving others is a noble cause, unless it's in the service industry; between bad customers and broken machines, it can be a total nightmare.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E04 — Who Let the Cons Out?
Convicts making last efforts to break free when their hands are tied; whether a crook on trial or an inmate with a corrections officer, handcuffs, cops and prison walls won't stop these guys from their escaping attempts.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E01 — Tased and Confused
Police takedowns can be risky business, especially when criminals are armed and dangerous; that's why officers rely on non-lethal tactics like tasers, bean bag rounds, and K-9 units to subdue suspects when things get a little too close for comfort.

title: Caught!
description:
It Seemed Like a Good Idea
A journey across America, where some stunts and moments unfold in unexpected places; adventures and escapades that redefine the boundaries of possibility.

title: Caught!
description:
Leave It to the Professionals
Amateurs attempt outrageous activities; hilarious stunts, spills, and thrills gone wrong showcase backyard engineering, clueless humans and uncooperative machinery.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S15 E10 — Confiscated Copper Conundrum
When police raid his underground still site, Josh joins Tickle and Henry in a shine run for a stock car legend; Mark and Digger contend with a rotten-egg taste in their blueberry brandy.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S15 E11 — Penny Wise, Impound Foolish
Josh constructs a decoy in a daring plot to retrieve his confiscated copper still from the police impound lot. Mike and Jerry promise to deliver something they've never attempted before. Mark and Huck face off with their own backwoods bear problem.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S15 E12 — Braking Badly
When the brakes fail on Mark and Huck's bootleg vehicle, their luck and their shine quickly hit rock bottom; Mike and Jerry cross police lines to get their shine back; Mark and Digger score a prized strain of wheat.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S15 E13 — Spirit Animal
Tim, Tickle and Henry confront the rogue shiners who torched their stash house; Mike and Jerry make liquor from candy roaster squash.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S15 E14 — Cocke County Crackdown
Mark and Digger team up with Josh to hunt down a police informant; Tim and Tickle plot revenge on shiners who destroyed $20,000 worth of their liquor.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S15 E15 — Wanted Drunk or Alive
Tickle makes tariff-free apple brandy to help resolve the shortage of American liquor on Canadian shelves; Mike and Jerry learn they're wanted men; Josh discovers the source of industrial ethanol.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S15 E16 — Outlaw & Order
Tim enlists Tickle to smuggle tariff-free shine by airplane and rallies a band of fellow outlaws to take back his family's turf; Mark and Digger turn the law against a counterfeiter; Mike and Jerry push Mark Rogers past his limit.

description:
S02 E10 — Battle of the Judges
Tim Smith challenges Mark and Digger to a moonshine-making rematch; the three legends face off to see who can bring the best jar of moonshine to the table and win the ultimate bragging rights.

title: Animals on Drugs
description:
S01 E01 — Meth Gators
In a methamphetamine hotspot, drugs seep into local waterways, creating aggressive alligators; wildlife biologist Forrest Galante investigates the effects of meth on these reptiles and attempts to capture and rehabilitate a meth gator.

title: Outlaw Tech
description:
S01 E05 — FBI Inside Job
A master hacker steals $400 million and eludes capture by the FBI, until the Feds realize he's one of them; millions in drugs are stolen from a super-secure warehouse; criminals run an elaborate scheme to steal a fortune worth of gas in plain sight.

title: Outlaw Tech
description:
S01 E02 — Cocaine Sub Wars
South American drug lords build a fleet of narco subs to carry cocaine to the US; a gambling addict masterminds a bold casino heist.

title: Outlaw Tech
description:
S01 E04 — Escape of El Chapo
Inside the science and engineering that helped El Chapo escape from the most guarded prison in Mexico; in just 10 hours, $40 million disappears from ATMs across the planet; a high-tech scheme turns the tables on a casino for a huge payout.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S02 E09 — The $8,000 Man
Officers stop a man suspected of money laundering; cocaine is found hidden in an unexpected area of a shipping truck; a traveler is caught trying to bring weaponry into Mexico; a father is stopped when trying to smuggle medication for his son.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S04 E11 — Ruffled Feathers
Officers receive a tip-off on a vehicle loaded with cartel cash; a man released from jail finds himself in trouble for smuggling hundreds of prescription pills; a magician comes under scrutiny for traveling with a dove he uses as a prop.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S04 E06 — Marshal Matters
Officers discover an illicit load in a shipment of garbage bags; a U.S. Marshal exhibits some disorderly conduct; a woman previously imprisoned for trafficking meth is found with an excessive amount of pills; knockoff luxury goods are uncovered.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S04 E07 — Going Out With a Bang
A retiring officer makes a significant bust before hanging up his hat; a bus arrives with more than just passengers in tow; a mother wanted on a nine-year-old warrant for theft is apprehended; a car unexpectedly explodes in the middle of a bridge.

title: How It's Made
description:
S15 E04 — Flight Simulators; Traditional Bookbinding; Greenhouse Tomatoes
Following the manufacturing processes behind flight simulators, traditional bookbinding, greenhouse tomatoes and hurricane-proof shutters.
